required_skills: Sound knowledge of accounting principles, standards, and regulations
Proficiency and hands-on experience with financial management software (e.g., Sage Intacct, BILL)
Superior data management and data analysis skills
Strong time management and organizational skills
Detail-oriented with a passion for accuracy
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
preferred_skills: Experience in financial management and accounting within a nonprofit organization or association
education_requirements: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or relevant field required
Master’s degree and/or CPA certification a plus
responsibilities: Managing day-to-day finance and accounting operations
Entering journals, managing accounts receivable and payable
Performing timely and accurate month-end journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations
Ensuring proper revenue and expense recognition
Monitoring cash and investment balances and performing cash flow forecasting
Ensuring compliance with GAAP and regulations
Assisting in developing and monitoring budgets
Communicating regularly with the Director of Finance
Implementing and training staff on financial software
requirements: 5 to 10 years in financial management and accounting
Occasional evening or weekend meetings or events may be required
